test_title: PYST 1: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six people, P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in a straight line, facing north. U sits fourth to the right of R. R is not sitting at the extreme end of the line. T is the immediate neighbour of U and S. Q sits third to the left of S.

Who is sitting immediately to the right of R?
solution:
**Given :** Six people, P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

**Explanation :**

1) U sits fourth to the right of R.

2) R is not sitting at the extreme end of the line.
